title: devscreen rebuilds and launches with a relative path that only works at the repo root
body:
`scripts/devscreen run` runs `cargo build` and then executes `target/debug/decade` relative to the current directory, with a hard-coded `-j4`. `scripts/launch` resolves the repository, builds and reports the error, and `decade-dev` links to it.

## Proposal

`devscreen run` executes the `decade-dev` link with `--class decade-dev`, so one script owns build-and-exec.
